# agx

> Command-line toolkit for coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex): plan usage for every account at once, launch on the account with the most headroom, resume a conversation on the account that stores it (or browse every folder's conversations with `agx ws`), move conversations between accounts, run any account's home on another account's quota with named logins (`agx login`, `--login`), and manage session folders.

agx is open source (khanakia/agx), written in Go. It reads the logins the agent CLIs already stored and makes one read-only GET per account to the vendor's own usage endpoint (api.anthropic.com, chatgpt.com); a vendor CLI's stored login is never refreshed, written or printed. Long-lived tokens you add with `agx login add` are kept in a private 0600 file (or read from your own command or env var), passed only to the agent's environment, and never printed; their usage is read by a tiny model request that runs only on request. There is no telemetry.

## Install
- Go: `go install github.com/khanakia/agx@latest`
- Binaries: https://github.com/khanakia/agx/releases (latest v0.3.3)
